guaranteedRewards.name: Proxy of Nozdormu
tooltip: Use: Target a friendly player to deputize them as an Agent of Nozdormu. As an Agent of Nozdormu, only you and your deputies may take the Silithid Carapace Fragments from the corpses of the silithid. Keep your badge in your pack at all times.
"Bears the Seal of the Bronze Flight"

narrative.details:
Choose your deputies wisely, mortal. Each time you return with your task complete, a new deputy you will be allowed to choose.

With that said, I require more of the carapace fragments. Waste no time!
narrative.objectives: Collect 200 Silithid Carapace Fragments and return to Baristolth.
narrative.offerRewardText: Well done, hero. You will now be granted the ability to deputize another Agent of Nozdormu.
narrative.requestItemsText: Perhaps one day the whole of Cenarion Hold will be working under your command.
